lines.en: Rippling skin as it moves, roaring

lines.zh: 粗重的呼吸声，缓慢前进

lines.en: Slow steps, big fists, coming for you.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞开灌木，闷头走来
lines.en: Its shoulder shoves the brush aside as it plods on.

lines.zh: 每走一步，地面轻轻一震
lines.en: The ground shudders faintly with each step.

lines.zh: 摇晃着身体，无意识地移动

lines.en: I stand at the village gate, swaying slowly.
Staring you down, slowly closing in

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，盯着你的护甲。
lines.en: I tilt my neck, staring at your armor.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉，也挡不住斧子。
lines.en: All this bulk of mine can't stop an axe.

lines.zh: 腐肉掉了一块，露出骨头。
lines.en: A chunk of rot falls away, showing bone.
I'm slow, and my pain comes slowly too.
You're like a feast to me!

lines.zh: 享受这一刻吧，然后变成我！
lines.en: Enjoy this moment, then become me!

lines.zh: 墙角窄，我的身板堵得住。
lines.en: The corner is narrow; my bulk plugs it.
One shove from me and you're three steps back.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀比你的盾还宽。
lines.en: My shoulder is broader than your shield.

lines.zh: 我比普通僵尸壮一倍，也慢一倍。
lines.en: Twice as strong as a zombie, half as fast.

lines.zh: 我走一步，地面都沉一下。
lines.en: Each step I take makes the ground sink.
I'm a size bigger than a common zombie.

lines.zh: 它巨大的咬合力让我颤栗。
lines.en: Its massive bite force sends shivers down my spine.

lines.zh: 它那双空洞的眼睛盯着我。
lines.en: Its hollow eyes fix on me.

lines.zh: 它的存在让我感到不安。
我弯腰，把整袋东西拎起来。
lines.en: I bend and lift the whole sack.
Its voice is deep and gruff.

lines.zh: 我看见它的眼睛里闪烁着野性。
它似乎随时都会扑过来。
lines.en: It seems ready to pounce at any moment.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸中带着腐烂的气息。
lines.en: Its breath is filled with decay.

lines.zh: 我瞄准了那个高大强壮的目标。
lines.en: I target the tall and sturdy figure.

lines.zh: 它的存在让周围的一切显得渺小。
lines.en: Its presence makes everything else seem small.
I feel the threat of it.

lines.zh: 它那庞大的身躯成为我的焦点。
lines.en: Its massive form becomes my focus.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着我，寻找弱点。
它的每一个动作都让我紧张。
lines.en: Every move of it makes me tense.

lines.zh: 它的存在使我更加警惕。
lines.en: Its presence makes me more vigilant.

lines.zh: 我必须先瞄准，才能打败它。
lines.en: I must target first before defeating it.

lines.zh: 它的体型让我觉得它难以战胜。
lines.en: Its size makes it seem hard to defeat.

lines.zh: 我紧紧盯着它的每一个动作。
lines.en: I closely watch every move it makes.

lines.zh: 四十格外的气味引它来了
lines.en: A scent forty blocks off has brought it here.
It lifts its head and locks on.

lines.zh: 它把挡路的栅栏整段推倒
lines.en: It shoves a whole fence section aside.
It spreads its arms and picks up speed.
It remembers the tree you hid behind.
I feel the threat from it.
I lower my head and aim my brow at you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把枯枝踩断。
lines.en: Step by step, I snap the dry branches.
I prepare to end the fight.
Its life is about to end.

lines.zh: 它压低肩膀准备撞过来
lines.en: It drops a shoulder, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 它走得不快，却从不偏离
lines.en: It is slow, but it never strays off line.
It pounds the air with its fists.
It snaps the dead branch under your feet.

lines.zh: 它把尸体拖开，腾出地方
lines.en: It drags a corpse aside to clear space.
It stares at you like a door to break down.

lines.zh: 每一步都比上一步更近
lines.en: Every step lands closer than the last.
I'm slow, but one punch is heavy.
Hey, get out of my way!
My steps are slow. My arms are heavy.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的头还大。
lines.en: My fist is bigger than your head.
One swipe sends you two paces back.

lines.zh: 它抓住你的衣领往下拽
lines.en: It grabs your collar and drags you down.

lines.zh: 它的额头撞上你的鼻梁
lines.en: Its forehead cracks into your nose.
It grinds you against the trunk.

lines.zh: 拳头落下，护甲凹了一块
lines.en: The fist lands and dents your armor.
It raises a foot and stomps where you stood.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，找到新伙伴了！
我从墓土里撑起半个身子。
lines.en: I push half my body up out of the grave soil.
Thicker than the others, and slower.
It pushes the grave soil aside and stands.

lines.zh: 村子外传来沉重的脚步
lines.en: Heavy steps sound outside the village.
It squeezes out of the pile of bodies.

lines.zh: 一个壮一圈的影子走近
lines.en: A silhouette a size larger than the rest walks in.

lines.zh: 嘶~ 又受伤了，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Agh! Got hurt again? — and the fire makes it worse.
